wok.src: [M] 美的 MC-E35D2 concave induction 3500 W (research/r15_cooking_market.md); pf [E]

zone2.src: [M] 米家电磁炉2 2100 W, MIoT (r15); BOM pick 米家电磁炉 N1 also 2100 W [O] ithome 0/788/518; pf [E]

stew.src: [E] 4-cup water-bath stew pot, 600 W at 220 V (a 1.2 L Tonze unit is 300 W [O]); x(230/220)^2

rice.src: [O] 米家电饭煲 C1 3 L (MDFBZ02ACM) 650 W at 220 V (listing snippet); x(230/220)^2

fryer.src: [O] Tefal Oleoclean Pro FR8040 2300 W, 3.5 L (galaxus / mediamarkt / mydealz listings)

kettle.src: [O] 1.7 L kettle, Philips HD9350 class 2200 W at 220-240 V (retail listings)

robot.src: UR5e 200 W typical / 570 W max [M datasheet]; IPC+sensors 60 W, gripper 24 W, drive supply 270 W [hardware.py allowances]; brake coils 40 W + safety sensors 20 W [E]; controller off-board on the same feed; pf [E]

station.src: [E] seasoning station 24 V PSU: dosing peak 150 W (doses during prep), 15 W idle

fridge.src: [E] single-door fridge, 150 W running, ~40 % duty; compressor start 5-8x for <1 s

hood.src: [O] slim hood class Fujioh FR-SC2090 85/125/160 W (hkele listing); run on high all meal [E]

misc.src: [E] knob servo, stove guard, smart plugs, kitchen light

plans.P0: repo today: new 20 A wok point; every other load on the existing kitchen socket circuit (2 outlets)
plans.P1: +1 new 20 A radial for the two big plug-in heaters (zone 2, fryer)
plans.P2: +2 new 20 A radials: heaters split three ways
